children: Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) is accelerating AI and logistics bets—ramping AWS GPU/CPU capacity, hosting Moonshot models, and building Project Tetromino—while boosting 2026 capex to ~$220B and aiming for AI breakeven in 2–3 years amid antitrust and regulatory risks.
Previous Week Recap
AMZN: AWS GPU Expansion
: AMZN: AWS will add 2M NVIDIA GPUs in 2027–28 after 1M in 2026, plus NVIDIA CPU nodes, NVLink Fusion, Nemotron support on Bedrock/SageMaker, Nitro/EFA networking, and 100k GPUs for U.S. federal AI.
Amazon Capital Spending Rise
: Amazon (AMZN) projects roughly $220 billion in 2026 capital spending, up $20 billion from prior plan, driven by continued AWS and cloud infrastructure investments.
Judge Denies Block, Final Injunction Pending

: Judge tentatively denied an injunction blocking Amazon’s alleged pricing practices, citing 2023 evidence may not show ongoing harm. Final injunction decision pending; antitrust trial set for January.
AI Infra Breakeven in 2–3 Years
: Amazon says AI infrastructure spend (servers, networking) should reach breakeven in 2–3 years; management cites stronger AI demand and potential faster cloud growth and profit expansion.
AWS Talks To Host Moonshot AI
: Amazon Web Services is in early talks to host Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 model for AMZN, discussing a revenue-share up to 30%, data access, and token-usage audit terms.
Project Tetromino AI Robot Delivery
: Amazon (AMZN) is building Project Tetromino: AI- and robot-driven automated delivery stations designed to sort and stage packages ~2.5x faster than current stations, per report.
Evercore Raises Target; Alexa Buyers, Reach
: Evercore raised AMZN 12‑month target to $355; survey shows 57% Alexa buyers, 92% retail reach, 49% use same‑day delivery, Prime spend 3.1x higher. Shares jumped ~3%.
Debt Markets Signal Higher AI Risk
: Debt markets price higher risk for Amazon (AMZN) as AI investments raise funding needs; long-term rates and credit costs now more directly affect Amazon's future borrowing costs.
Alexa AI Survey: Purchases, Share
: Survey: 57% of Alexa AI users bought items they hadn’t known. AMZN online retail share ~92%. Same‑day delivery used by 49%. Prime users using same‑day delivery spend 3.1x more.
Delivery Protection Act — NYC Impact
: NYC mayor backed Delivery Protection Act, which could force warehouses to get city licenses, meet safety and hiring rules, and may affect Amazon’s NYC operations and courier staffing.
